Uuid.description: Opaque UUID v4. Resource identifiers are never reused.

TraceId.description: W3C trace-id. All-zero values are invalid.

LogNumber.description: Server-issued LOG- prefixed ULID. Globally unique, immutable, non-reusable and free of business metadata.

effective_role_assignment_ids.description: Authoritative role-assignment references, not caller-supplied role names.

run_context_id.description: Opaque short-lived server-side run context reference. It is not a signed grant.

ip_address.description: Canonical IPv4 or IPv6 address resolved at the trusted ingress.

message.description: Generic user-safe text. Authorization denials never expose resource metadata.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to tenant, user, scope, filter and ordering.

total.description: Count after authorization and scope filtering, before page slicing.

ResourceVersion.description: Monotonic resource version returned in both the body and ETag.

AuditReason.description: Human or policy reason stored in audit data and never echoed in denial text.

AuditDetails.description: Whitelisted metadata only; prompts, credentials, tokens and file content are excluded.

SseRunEvent.x-dixian-resume: Last-Event-ID is the decimal sequence; replay only the same run after that sequence

value.description: Absent only for self scope. Values are opaque server-side resource references.

SessionCookie.name: dixian_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict platform session cookie scoped to /api/v1.

PortalResourceKey.name: resource_key
PortalResourceKey.description: Stable C01 department, module or Agent key. Hidden resources return 404.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Required on private hops; public ingress always issues it.

LogNumber.name: X-Log-Number
LogNumber.description: Required on private hops; public client values are ignored.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted ResourceVersion expected by update and delete operations.

AuditReason.name: X-Audit-Reason
AuditReason.description: Required by policy for privileged, approval, security and destructive writes.

InvalidRequest.description: Request payload or query is invalid

HiddenNotFound.description: Resource missing or deliberately hidden by policy

NotFound.description: Requested authorization resource does not exist

Conflict.description: State, version, idempotency or resume conflict
